fact: Never use expect_identical() on C++ double return values. Use expect_equal(tolerance = N * .Machine$double.eps).
why: FMA vs non-FMA code generation causes 1-3 ULP differences across platforms.

fact: Cross-platform tolerance for bootstrap tests: tolerance = n_boot * .Machine$double.eps, not a fixed constant.
why: Each bootstrap replicate accumulates one FP rounding step. n_boot=500 → bound ~1.1e-13.

fact: expect_equal() near zero: add scale=1 for absolute comparison.
why: Relative tolerance divides by |target|; ratio explodes when target ≈ 0.

fact: Any package called in tests must be in Suggests, even inside tryCatch().
why: R CMD check flags unstated dependencies regardless of guards.

fact: Don't extrapolate serial cost linearly for multi-pass NR. rob_scale_compute calls rho_sum ~5x per call; serial traffic at n=32768 is ~2.6MB.
why: Linear extrapolation from n=8192 raised parallel threshold too high → 33% regression at n=32768.

fact: Sub-µs benchmarks are unreliable (timer quantum ~450ns). Crossover points bounce across runs. Use theoretical analysis or require 3-run consensus for sub-µs sizes.
why: n=8..32 times cluster at 4-5 quanta; SOLO baselines at n≤65 carry ±1 quantum of capture noise.

fact: covr::package_coverage() with GCC -flto strips .Call() exports not referenced at link time (C_sn_sorted, C_qn_sorted). Tests fail in covr but pass in devtools::test().
why: LTO + --coverage removes symbols only referenced via R's .Call() at runtime. Pre-existing issue.

fact: Extracted hot inner-loop templates need __attribute__((always_inline)), not just static inline. GCC/Clang may refuse to inline across multiple call sites at -O2.
why: sn_inner_serial with plain static inline showed ~5x regression at n=1000.

fact: Gate scripts default to CAPTURE mode (no args). Always run with CHECK for verification. rob_scale_gate_check.R must use SOLO (H2H requires removed diagnostic export).
why: Default CAPTURE overwrites baseline with post-change code. H2H crashes after diagnostic export removal.

fact: Cap mclapply workers with safe_worker_count() — detectCores() workers × ~1GB each can exceed available RAM.
why: 16 workers × ~800MB crashed under swap pressure even after fixing inner boot::boot parallelism.

fact: tar_invalidate() cascades through stale upstream file-hash targets, triggering full pipeline rerun. Run tar_outdated() first.
why: Invalidating speedup_figure_obj after R CMD INSTALL reran the entire 2h benchmark pipeline.

fact: NEVER add Aitken/Steffensen to robLoc. It uses quadratic NR (observed Hessian), not linear IRLS. Aitken cannot improve on 2-3 step convergence.
why: For quadratic NR, T'(t*)=0; minimum Aitken cost equals the baseline. No savings possible.

fact: Place shared C++ template helpers BEFORE any #ifdef block that uses them. The compiler parses all branches even when the condition is off.
why: Template inserted after TBB #ifdef → 'not declared in this scope' when TBB enabled.

fact: Pin tests iterate over n values sequentially; each rnorm(n) consumes exactly n draws. Skipping or reordering any n shifts all subsequent sequences.
why: Script starting at n=5 instead of n=4 shifted every later sequence → 100+ spurious failures.

fact: bench::mark() with 2 expressions: bm$median is a 2-element vector. Use bm$median[[1]] for scalar extraction.
why: as.numeric(bm$median) silently writes 2 values into baseline RDS, corrupting the format.

fact: The rob_scale_core implosion guard gap (0 < s_init ≤ IMPLOSION_BOUND, fallback=0) is intentional. NR handles any positive s_init; ADM does NOT downweight outliers.
why: c(1e-4, 0, 0, 4): NR gives correct ~1e-4 reflecting bulk; ADM gives ~1.25 including outlier.

fact: R's any(!is.finite(x)) allocates a length-n logical vector (~3.9µs at n=1000). Use C++ validate_finite instead.
why: R-side validation was 40-69% of estimator call time (sd_c4: 69%, robScale: 55%, adm: 65%).

fact: Use [[Rcpp::export(rng = false)]] for all estimators. R::qnorm/pnorm/qchisq are deterministic — only R::rnorm/runif/rbinom need RNGScope.
why: rng=false saved 20% on sd_c4. Package now has 0 RNGScope instances.

fact: compute_all_estimators: results[0]=sd_c4, results[1]=gmd, but API maps estimator_id 0=gmd, 1=sd_c4. BCa jackknife needs kEstIdToAllIdx remapping at BOTH call sites.
why: Without remapping, BCa CIs for gmd and sd_c4 use wrong leave-one-out values.

fact: Per-element !std::isfinite checks in copy loops prevent autovectorization. Validate at boundary once, then use clean std::memcpy.
why: qn/sn copy loops with per-element checks couldn't use SIMD. Separate scan + memcpy fixed it.

fact: Audit parameter usage across ALL code paths. Multi-parameter signatures can hide dead buffers on the hot path.
why: rob_scale_core's dev buffer was only used on a rare fallback; 50% of arena allocation was dead weight.

fact: Never call RuntimeConfig::get() inside per-replicate functions. Hoist to loop boundary; pass as parameter.
why: 1000 TLS lookups per scale_robust() call in ensemble bootstrap.

fact: When hoisting a TLS read from callee to caller, the caller's #if guard must be at least as broad as the callee's.
why: Hoisting from #if TBB && AVX2 left flag undefined on non-TBB AVX2 builds. Must use #if AVX2.

fact: Never change cache-derived thresholds without a pre-change baseline on the same hardware. Constant per-call reductions shift y-intercept, not slope.
why: Changed divisor 4→2 based on post-optimization benchmark with no pre-optimization reference.

fact: ROBSCALE_TARGET_AVX2 functions must contain the vectorizable loop body directly. Delegation to non-attributed callees via plain inline loses AVX2 codegen.
why: adm_core_avx2 delegating to adm_core_scalar caused 6-9% regression at n=1024-4096.

fact: H2H regression benchmarks must include scale_robust(x, auto_switch=FALSE). Standalone estimators don't exercise ensemble bootstrap/BCa paths.
why: Ensemble uses parallel TBB bootstrap and BCa CI code not touched by any standalone estimator.
